welcomeTitle: Everything your society needs, in one app
welcomeBody: Dues, notices, duties and help. All in one place.
termsNote: By continuing you agree to the Privacy Policy. Tap to read it.
forgotBody: If your account has an email, we will send a reset link. No email? Ask your society admin for a reset code.
linkSent: If that account exists, a link is on its way.

one.title: One app for the whole building.
one.body: Notices, dues, meetings, parking, help. All in one place, for every flat.

two.title: Pay dues in two taps.
two.body: See what you owe, pay by UPI, and keep the receipt in the app.

three.title: Find your way with the AR guide.
three.body: Point your phone at a plate in the lobby and follow the arrows to any flat.

registerBody: Your name, a way to reach you, and a password.
resetBody: Type the code from the email or from your admin, and choose a new password.
